title: 第9章 法器妙威，可愿当住持
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
皎月当空，星辰泛泛。
庭院内，一群弟子站在四方廊道上，兴奋的叫喝着，只见青苦正在与姜长生切磋。
姜长生立于原地，脚步未曾挪动，左手负于腰后，右手抵挡青苦，任凭青苦任何进攻，总能被他轻松化解，再顺势推出去。
十六岁的他丰神俊逸，在人群中极为出众。
青苦修行了姜长生传授的九寻天龙步，此步法精妙，但没有实质性的攻击力，所以青苦的进攻招式是龙起观的武学。
不得不说，龙起观的大部分武学都很菜，在姜长生看来，跟前世地球的传统武学没有区别。
姜长生再次单手推开青苦，青苦连退七步，一个踉跄，跌坐在地。
青苦无奈叫道：“不来了。”
周围的弟子纷纷叫好，称赞三师兄厉害。
自从达到道法自然功第四层后，姜长生偶尔会指点其他弟子，三师兄的形象因此建立起来，威望日渐上涨。
姜长生刚准备询问还有谁想指教，庭院的大门被推开，众人扭头看去，顿时吓得跑回自己的房间。
青苦连忙爬起来，迅速跑回屋内，庭院内只剩下姜长生与来者。
“三师弟，大晚上的要早睡觉，别惯着这些小兔崽子们胡闹。”
孟秋河走到姜长生面前，语重心长的说道，他紧皱眉头，两鬓竟出现几缕白发。
短短两年，他判若两人，曾经活泼开朗的二师兄，如今变成嗜武如疯的阴沉男子……
姜长生心中感慨，说到底，还是因他，倘若他没有被救到龙起观，情况就不一样。
但这一切也并非他导致的，他也是受害者。
姜长生笑道：“好的，大师兄。”
孟秋河盯着他，目光灼灼道：“三师弟，两年前，你就能诛杀邪王，如今有多强？何时与我切磋？”
姜长生不想打击孟秋河，婉拒道：“算了，当初只是邪王大意，我其实不是他的对手，大师兄，我累了，先回去休息了，有空一起练剑。”

说完，他转身走向自己的房屋。
孟秋河问道：“听闻李长青已经踏入绝顶之境，三师弟，你可想下山闯荡一番？”
这么快？
莫非修炼了魔功？
姜长生暗自想到，他摆了摆手，道：“我不想下山，我只想待在龙起观，与世无争。”
孟秋河目送着他入屋，方才转身离去。
回到床榻上，姜长生皱起眉头。
孟秋河刚才那话是什么意思？
这家伙也想学李长青？
他想了一会儿，便决定不要多管闲事，然后开始闭目练功。
次日一早，他敲完道钟回来，青苦不在屋内，于是他将麒麟拂尘从脑海里拿出来，他担心生存奖励取出后不能放回去，所以一直没有拿，现在也该拿了。
这段时间里，他将御剑诀彻底掌握，平时除了修炼道法自然功，也没有其他事情可以做，倒不如玩玩法器。
麒麟拂尘凭空出现在他手中，此拂尘看起来与寻常拂尘没有区别，但握柄呈白玉色，又似一根白骨。
他握住麒麟拂尘，能感受到里面涌动的法力，不愧是法器，自带灵力。
他脑海里涌现出一段记忆，告诉他如何让法器认主，他开始效仿，将神识探入麒麟拂尘内，攻破法器内部的禁制。
半个时辰，麒麟拂尘成功认主于他，认主之后，麒麟拂尘开始自主地吸收天地灵气，很是神奇。
当姜长生往麒麟拂尘内注入灵力后，上面的长须竟可自如的伸长，而且他还能掌控它们，进行捆绑、击打等动作。
姜长生试着将麒麟拂尘放回脑海里，果然失败了。
生存奖励的物品一旦取出，就只能存在于现实中。
他虽有些遗憾，但也能如此。

从此以后，姜长生腰间佩着太行剑，手中握着麒麟拂尘，仙风道骨，当有弟子询问这把拂尘时，他说是陈礼送的，观内弟子都知道陈礼与四皇子偶尔会来看望他。
不止是这两人，也有其他达官贵人想要拜访姜长生，一开始他还接见，但次数多了便婉拒，因为那些人只是想见识一下他，没有陈礼的诚意。
夏日炎炎，烤得空间都在微微扭曲。
“长生哥，我要去从军，五年之内，我不能来看望你，希望你见谅。”
少年郎在姜长生面前，意气风发的说道，他双手插腰，满头大汗，但精力依旧亢奋。
姜长生刚指点完神影腿，正想逐客，没想到他说出这番话。
姜长生问道：“你要去哪儿从军？不在京城？”
大景朝立国十六载，内部和谐太平，但对外的征战未曾停下过，北边一直在征战，每年都会诞生一批军功卓越的将军。
姜誉笑道：“自然是往北，我要踏平大漠，灭了他古汗。”
古汗，是大景朝北边的王朝，地域辽阔，时常侵略周边王朝，大景朝的前身楚朝曾有一段岁月被古汗攻破，沦陷大半国土，皇室、百姓皆受尽屈辱，导致大景朝的人对古汗仍有着刻在骨子里的仇恨。
当今皇帝除了追求长生外，最大的目标就是踏平古汗，成就千古奇功。
姜长生笑道：“皇子参军，可没那么轻松，你可得想好。”
姜誉咧嘴笑道：“没办法啊，不入军，争不过我大哥。”
姜长生愣住，这还是姜誉第一次朝他吐露野心。
假太子的派系越发强大，据说六部已有两部被他掌控，京城的衙门还是他亲自监管，十六岁已具备处理政务的能力，已经有不少人期待他登基后会为大景带来怎样的盛世。
至于当今皇帝，民间对其颇有微词，修运河实在是劳民伤财。
姜长生跟着道：“那就祝你顺利。”
姜誉好奇问道：“倘若这些年，我大哥或者其他皇子前来拉拢你，你会下山吗？”
他看似随意，心里紧张极了。
姜长生摇头失笑：“自然不会，我若为名利，早就听陛下的话，前去参加武科举。”

姜誉露出笑容，转身离去。
“长生哥，等着我策马回京，我会将你的武学在战场上发扬光大！”
楼宇间回荡着少年的大笑声，十四岁的他信心满满，朝气冲天。
姜长生看向身边的糕点，露出遗憾之色。
以后很长时间吃不到这么好吃的糕点了。
四皇子离京，并没有在京城掀起波澜，当今皇子超过十位，又已册立太子，四皇子的存在感并不高。
姜长生突破道法自然功第四层后并没有松懈，每日都在努力练功。
日子一天天过去，龙起观内的树叶开始泛黄，预示着秋季即将到来。
龙起观已经恢复以往，隔三差五便有达官贵人前来烧香求道，也有侠客前来借住，静养心神，姜长生虽是三弟子，但平时没有接待客人，都是其他弟子负责，目前统管龙起观的是二师姐孟秋霜。
孟秋河与孟秋霜是亲生兄妹，幼年父母被强盗所杀，幸得清虚道长所救，一同带上山。
正午时分，姜长生打坐在道钟楼上，面朝骄阳，运功纳气，吸收着天地间的天气。
青苦忽然跑到楼下喊道：“大事不好了，师兄，大师兄又跑了！”
姜长生睁眼，起身来得护栏前俯视青苦，问道：“什么意思？你说孟师兄，还是李师兄？”
“当然是孟师兄，准确的说是又跑了一位大师兄！”
青苦急声道，语气焦急。
姜长生皱眉，翻身一跃，如同一只白鹤轻飘飘地落下，青苦已经习惯他的身法，立即带路。
两人迅速来得明心殿前，大部分弟子聚集于此，没来的要么负责看守山门，要么负责招待客人。
殿内，清虚道长背对着他们，手里握着一封书信，沉默不语。
孟秋霜咬牙道：“师父，徒儿去找他！”
姜长生诧异，孟秋河下山不带自己的妹妹？

清虚道长叹息一声：“不用了，尊重他吧，秋河与长青不同，并非投靠魔门，他只是想求取更强大的力量，日后在京城，或许你们还能再见到他。”
他转过身来，看向众弟子。
姜长生见他表情平静，看来早有猜测。
“大弟子之位就交由秋霜担任吧，其他弟子依次提升名分。”清虚道长开口道。
姜长生变成了二师兄，他心里有些无奈，这晋升速度太快了。
不会再等两年，他就成大师兄了吧？
“长生，跟我来。”
清虚道长挥动拂尘，转身离去，姜长生一听，连忙跟上。
其他弟子则继续讨论孟秋河下山之事。
穿过明心殿，进入一条长长的廊道，外界的喧哗渐渐远去，姜长生跟在清虚道长身后，浮想联翩，不知他要说什么。
姜长生还是很想知道清虚道长是否知晓他的身世，又有什么看法，这样才好决定如何复仇。
他还不确定京城内是否有人能敌得过自己，必须小心。
一路来到一座幽静的庭院内，院子不大，坐落着一棵老树，树身蜿蜒如龙躯，茂密的秋叶随风飘动，地上已经堆积起一圈黄环。
清虚道长停下，望着老树，缓缓开口道：“长生，可想下山？”
姜长生愣住，连忙问道：“师父为何要驱我下山？”
他没想到清虚道长会是这个意思。
清虚道长平静道：“倘若你不愿下山，日后可愿当龙起观的住持？”
content_en:
The bright moon is in the sky, and the stars are everywhere.
In the courtyard, a group of disciples stood on the square corridor, shouting excitedly, and saw Qing Ku competing with Jiang Changsheng.
Jiang Changsheng stood on the spot without moving, his left hand behind his waist, and his right hand resisting Qing Ku. No matter how Qing Ku attacked, he could always be easily defused by him and pushed out.
At the age of sixteen, he was handsome and outstanding among the crowd.
Qing Ku practiced the Jiuxun Tianlong Step taught by Jiang Changsheng. This step is exquisite, but has no substantial offensive power, so Qing Ku's offensive moves are the martial arts of Long Qiguan.
It has to be said that most of Long Qiguan's martial arts are very bad. In Jiang Changsheng's opinion, there is no difference from the traditional martial arts of the earth in his previous life.
Jiang Changsheng pushed Qing Ku away with one hand again. Qing Ku took seven steps back, staggered, and fell to the ground.
Qing Ku shouted helplessly: "I'm not coming."
The surrounding disciples applauded and praised the third senior brother for his greatness.
Since reaching the fourth level of Taoist natural skills, Jiang Changsheng has occasionally given instructions to other disciples. As a result, the image of the third senior brother has been established, and his prestige has increased day by day.
Just as Jiang Changsheng was about to ask who else wanted to give advice, the door to the courtyard was pushed open. Everyone turned to look, and immediately ran back to their rooms in fright.
Qing Ku quickly got up and ran back into the house. Only Jiang Changsheng and the visitor were left in the courtyard.
"Third Junior Brother, you should go to bed early at night, and don't let these little brats fool around."
Meng Qiuhe walked up to Jiang Changsheng and spoke earnestly. He frowned and a few strands of white hair appeared on his temples.
In just two years, he has become a completely different person. The once lively and cheerful second senior brother has now become a gloomy man who is crazy about martial arts...
Jiang Changsheng sighed in his heart. In the final analysis, it was still because of him. If he had not been rescued to Longqi Temple, the situation would have been different.
But he was not the cause of all this, he was also a victim.
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said, "Okay, Senior Brother."
Meng Qiuhe stared at him with stern eyes and said, "Third Junior Brother, you were able to kill the Evil King two years ago. How strong are you now? When will you compete with me?"
Jiang Changsheng didn't want to hit Meng Qiuhe, so he politely declined: "Forget it, it was just the evil king's carelessness at first, and I am actually no match for him. Senior brother, I'm tired, so I'll go back and rest first. Let's practice swordplay together when we have time."
After saying that, he turned and walked towards his house.
Meng Qiuhe asked: "I heard that Li Changqing has reached the ultimate level, third junior brother, do you want to go down the mountain and try your luck?"
So fast?
Could it be that he has practiced magic skills?
Jiang Changsheng thought to himself, waved his hand and said: "I don't want to go down the mountain, I just want to stay at Longqi Temple and have nothing to do with the world."
Meng Qiuhe watched him enter the house, then turned and left.
Returning to the bed, Jiang Changsheng frowned.
What did Meng Qiuhe mean by what he just said?
This guy also wants to imitate Li Changqing?
He thought for a while, then decided not to meddle in other people's business, and then started practicing with his eyes closed.
Early the next morning, when he came back from ringing the bell, Qing Ku was not in the house, so he took the unicorn whisk out of his mind. He was worried that he would not be able to put it back after taking out the survival reward, so he never took it, and it was time to take it now.
During this period of time, he completely mastered the sword-controlling technique. Apart from practicing Taoist natural skills, he had nothing else to do, so he might as well play with the instrument.
A Kirin whisk appeared in his hand out of thin air. The whisk looked the same as an ordinary whisk, but the handle was white jade and resembled a white bone.
He held the unicorn whisk and could feel the magic power surging inside. It was indeed a magic weapon, with its own spiritual power.
A memory emerged in his mind, telling him how to make the magic weapon recognize its owner, and he began to follow suit, inserting his spiritual consciousness into the unicorn fly whisk to break through the restrictions inside the magic weapon.
After half an hour, the unicorn whisk successfully recognized him as its master. After recognizing its master, the unicorn whisk began to absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth independently, which was very miraculous.
When Jiang Changsheng injected spiritual power into the Kirin Whisk, the long beards on it could extend freely, and he could also control them.Perform actions such as binding and beating.
Jiang Changsheng tried to put the Qilin Whisk back into his mind, but he failed.
Once the survival reward items are taken out, they can only exist in reality.
Although he was a little regretful, he could still do this.
From then on, Jiang Changsheng wore the Taihang Sword on his waist and held the Kirin Whisk and Immortal Wind Taoist Bones in his hand. When a disciple asked about this whisk, he said it was a gift from Chen Li. All the disciples in the temple knew that Chen Li and the Fourth Prince would occasionally visit him.
Not only these two people, but also other dignitaries wanted to visit Jiang Changsheng. At first, he accepted them, but after many times, he declined because those people just wanted to meet him and did not have Chen Li's sincerity.
The summer is so hot that the space is slightly distorted.
"Brother Changsheng, I'm going to join the army. I won't be able to visit you within five years. I hope you can forgive me."
The young man said energetically in front of Jiang Changsheng. He had his hands on his waist and was sweating profusely, but his energy was still high.
Jiang Changsheng had just finished pointing out the divine shadow's legs and was about to expel the guests, but he didn't expect him to say these words.
Jiang Changsheng asked: "Where are you going to join the army? Not in the capital?"
The Great Jing Dynasty had been in existence for sixteen years, and the country was harmonious and peaceful internally. However, the external wars never stopped. There were constant wars in the north, and a group of generals with outstanding military achievements were born every year.
Jiang Yu smiled and said: "Of course we are going north. I want to flatten the desert and destroy his ancient Khan."
The ancient Khan was a dynasty to the north of the Great Jing Dynasty. It had a vast territory and often invaded surrounding dynasties. The Chu Dynasty, the predecessor of the Great Jing Dynasty, was conquered by the ancient Khan for a period of time and fell to most of the country. Both the royal family and the people suffered humiliation. As a result, the people of the Great Jing Dynasty still had hatred for the ancient Khan engraved in their bones.
In addition to pursuing immortality, the current emperor's biggest goal is to defeat the ancient Khan and achieve eternal achievements.
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said: "It's not that easy for a prince to join the army. You have to think carefully."
Jiang Yu grinned and said, "There is nothing I can do. If I don't join the army, I won't be able to compete with my eldest brother."
Jiang Changsheng was stunned. This was the first time Jiang Yu confided his ambition to him.
The fake prince's faction is becoming more and more powerful. It is said that two of the six departments are controlled by him. He still personally supervises the yamen in the capital. He has the ability to handle government affairs at the age of sixteen. Many people are already looking forward to what kind of prosperity he will bring to the great scene after he ascends the throne.
As for the current emperor, the people are quite critical of him. Building the canal is really a waste of people and money.
Jiang Changsheng followed: "Then I wish you good luck."
Jiang Yu asked curiously: "If my eldest brother or other princes came to win over you in these years, would you come down from the mountain?"
He seemed casual, but he was extremely nervous.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and laughed: "Of course not. If I were for fame and fortune, I would have listened to Your Majesty and gone to take part in the martial arts examination."
Jiang Yu smiled, turned and left.
"Brother Changsheng, wait until I ride back to Beijing, and I will carry forward your martial arts skills on the battlefield!"
The building echoed with the boy's laughter. At the age of fourteen, he was full of confidence and vitality.
Jiang Changsheng looked at the cakes beside him with a look of regret.
I won’t be able to eat such delicious pastries for a long time.
The fourth prince's departure from the capital did not cause any ripples in the capital. There were now more than ten princes, and the crown princes had been appointed. The presence of the four princes was not high.
Jiang Changsheng did not relax after breaking through the fourth level of Taoist natural skills and practiced hard every day.
As the days pass, the leaves in Longqi Temple begin to turn yellow, indicating that autumn is coming.
Longqi Temple has returned to its previous state. Every once in a while, dignitaries and dignitaries come to burn incense and seek enlightenment, and knights also come to stay and rest their minds. Although Jiang Changsheng is the third disciple, he usually does not receive guests. Other disciples are responsible. Currently, the person in charge of Longqi Temple is the second senior sister Meng Qiu Shuang.
Meng Qiuhe and Meng Qiushuang are biological brothers and sisters. Their parents were killed by bandits when they were young. Fortunately, they were rescued by Taoist Master Qingxu and took them up the mountain together.
At noon, Jiang Changsheng sat meditating on the Dao Bell Tower, facing the scorching sun, exercising his energy and absorbing the energy of heaven and earth.weather.
Qing Ku suddenly ran downstairs and shouted: "Something bad has happened, senior brother, senior brother has run away again!"
Jiang Changsheng opened his eyes, stood up, looked down at Qing Ku in front of the guardrail, and asked, "What do you mean? Are you talking about Senior Brother Meng, or Senior Brother Li?"
"Of course it's Senior Brother Meng. To be precise, another senior brother has escaped!"
Qing Ku said anxiously, his tone anxious.
Jiang Changsheng frowned, turned over and jumped, landing lightly like a white crane. Qing Ku, already accustomed to his movement, immediately led the way.
The two quickly arrived in front of the Mingxin Hall, where most of the disciples gathered. Those who didn't come were either responsible for guarding the gate or entertaining guests.
In the hall, Taoist Priest Qingxu turned his back to them, holding a letter in his hand and remaining silent.
Meng Qiu Shuang gritted her teeth and said: "Master, disciple, go find him!"
Jiang Changsheng was surprised. Meng Qiuhe went down the mountain without his sister?
Taoist Priest Qingxu sighed: "No, respect him. Qiuhe is different from Changqing. He is not seeking refuge with the Demon Sect. He just wants to gain more power. Maybe you can see him again in the capital in the future."
He turned around and looked at the disciples.
Seeing his calm expression, Jiang Changsheng seemed to have already made a guess.
"Let Qiu Shuang take over the position of top disciple, and the other disciples will be promoted in order." Taoist Master Qingxu said.
Jiang Changsheng became the second senior brother, and he felt a little helpless. This promotion was too fast.
He won't wait another two years and he will become the senior brother, right?
"Changsheng, come with me."
Taoist Master Qingxu waved his whisk, turned and left. Jiang Changsheng heard this and quickly followed.
Other disciples continued to discuss Meng Qiuhe's descent from the mountain.
After passing through the Mingxin Hall and entering a long corridor, the noise from the outside world gradually faded away. Jiang Changsheng followed Taoist Priest Qingxu, thinking about what he wanted to say.
Jiang Changsheng still wanted to know whether Taoist Master Qingxu knew about his life experience and what his opinion was, so that he could decide how to take revenge.
He is still not sure if anyone in the capital can defeat him, so he must be careful.
All the way we came to a quiet courtyard. The courtyard was not big, and there was an old tree. The tree body was as winding as a dragon's body. The dense autumn leaves were fluttering in the wind, and a circle of yellow rings had accumulated on the ground.
Taoist Master Qingxu stopped, looked at the old tree, and slowly said: "Changsheng, do you want to go down the mountain?"
Jiang Changsheng was stunned and asked quickly: "Why did Master drive me down the mountain?"
He didn't expect Taoist Master Qingxu to mean this.
Taoist Master Qingxu said calmly: "If you don't want to go down the mountain, would you like to be the abbot of Longqi Temple in the future?"
